control: Approve the exit scope, decision authority, business objective, and systems in scope
required_evidence: Approved exit charter naming executive sponsor, technical lead, security lead, service owner, and authorized environments
validation_method: Confirm current written approval and named decision makers
risk_if_missing: Uncoordinated actions can interrupt service or exceed authority
rollback_or_contingency: Pause execution and return to the approved scope
notes: Keep customer and regulated environments explicitly separated

control: Review notice periods, termination rights, minimum commitments, renewal dates, and transition-assistance terms
required_evidence: Executed agreement, order forms, amendments, renewal notices, and counsel-reviewed obligations
validation_method: Map each obligation to an owner and due date; obtain qualified legal review where needed
risk_if_missing: Missed dates or unsupported assumptions can create cost and legal exposure
rollback_or_contingency: Escalate disputed obligations and preserve the existing service while reviewed
notes: This register is operational guidance, not legal advice

control: Inventory final fees, true-ups, export charges, professional services, and overlap costs
required_evidence: Source-dated cost schedule and approved exit budget
validation_method: Reconcile quoted charges to contract terms and finance records
risk_if_missing: Unknown costs can delay exports, migration, or termination
rollback_or_contingency: Reserve approved contingency and prioritize critical exports
notes: Record currency, tax treatment, and assumptions

control: Define planned-exit, emergency-exit, vendor-failure, and security-incident triggers
required_evidence: Trigger matrix with thresholds, authority, communications, and response targets
validation_method: Run a tabletop for at least one planned and one emergency scenario
risk_if_missing: The team may improvise during an outage or security event
rollback_or_contingency: Use the approved emergency control path and minimum-service plan
notes: Do not assume the vendor console will remain reachable

control: Reconcile every managed tenant, site, endpoint, server, network device, and excluded asset
required_evidence: Exported inventory matched to CMDB, billing, identity, and network sources
validation_method: Compare counts and durable identifiers across independent sources
risk_if_missing: Untracked assets can retain agents or lose monitoring
rollback_or_contingency: Quarantine unresolved assets and retain bounded source coverage
notes: Preserve source timestamps and reconciliation exceptions

control: Inventory RMM policies, monitors, alerts, patch rings, schedules, scripts, automation, roles, reports, and custom fields
required_evidence: Configuration inventory with owner, scope, dependency, export method, and replacement disposition
validation_method: Sample each object type and confirm counts against the source console
risk_if_missing: Operational logic may disappear during cutover
rollback_or_contingency: Freeze nonessential changes and retain controlled read access where contractually allowed
notes: Classify secrets separately from reusable configuration

control: Export device, hardware, software, warranty, user, alert, job, patch, audit, and activity history required for operations or records
required_evidence: Source-native exports with field definitions, filters, time range, tenant scope, and checksums
validation_method: Open files independently; verify row counts, date coverage, identifiers, encoding, and tenant completeness
risk_if_missing: Historical evidence and operational context may be lost
rollback_or_contingency: Repeat exports before access ends and preserve screenshots of export criteria
notes: Store sensitive exports only in approved evidence storage

control: Test API pagination, rate limits, field coverage, timestamps, and deletion semantics before relying on bulk extraction
required_evidence: Documented API test results, sample payloads, pagination proof, and error logs
validation_method: Reconcile API output to console counts for representative tenants and object types
risk_if_missing: Silent truncation or field gaps can create incomplete archives
rollback_or_contingency: Use supported bulk export or vendor-assisted extraction and document residual gaps
notes: Do not place API tokens in this register

control: Preserve required reports, audit trails, approvals, exceptions, and incident evidence with retention authority
required_evidence: Records schedule, legal or compliance holds, approved evidence locations, and immutable hashes where appropriate
validation_method: Confirm access by an authorized reviewer outside the source RMM
risk_if_missing: Required records may become unavailable after termination
rollback_or_contingency: Escalate holds and delay destructive steps until records are secured
notes: Apply least privilege and data-minimization requirements

control: Export scripts and automation source with version, interpreter, owner, parameters, dependencies, signatures, and intended scope
required_evidence: Version-controlled source package plus dependency and secret-reference inventory
validation_method: Reproduce hashes and review a sample without exposing embedded credentials
risk_if_missing: Critical work may fail or unsafe legacy logic may be copied blindly
rollback_or_contingency: Disable unverified automation and use documented manual procedures
notes: Never migrate secrets by copying them into source files

control: Inventory PSA, ticketing, identity, documentation, security, billing, chat, webhook, API, and email integrations
required_evidence: Integration register with direction, scope, authentication method, owner, data flow, and shutdown sequence
validation_method: Trace representative create, update, failure, retry, and disable paths
risk_if_missing: Orphaned integrations can leak data or create duplicate work
rollback_or_contingency: Disable at the narrowest approved boundary and retain manual routing
notes: Include service accounts, certificates, and IP allowlists

control: Identify vendor-issued tokens, service accounts, certificates, webhooks, SSO applications, local credentials, and recovery methods
required_evidence: Credential disposition register referencing the approved secrets system
validation_method: Verify owner, consumers, rotation or revocation method, and last-use evidence
risk_if_missing: Credentials can remain usable after the commercial relationship ends
rollback_or_contingency: Revoke high-risk credentials and activate documented break-glass access
notes: Record references only; never put secret values in the CSV

control: Approve target-platform requirements, gaps, compensating controls, and go/no-go acceptance criteria
required_evidence: Signed requirements matrix, pilot evidence, defect log, risk decisions, and acceptance thresholds
validation_method: Trace each critical source capability to verified target evidence or an approved alternative
risk_if_missing: Migration may remove essential monitoring, access, patching, or reporting
rollback_or_contingency: Keep bounded source coverage and delay the affected wave
notes: Vendor demos are not acceptance evidence

control: Validate target tenant structure, roles, MFA, conditional access, audit logging, integrations, and secure agent enrollment
required_evidence: Target security baseline and controlled test evidence
validation_method: Have an independent authorized reviewer verify privileged controls
risk_if_missing: A rushed replacement can create broader access or weaker evidence
rollback_or_contingency: Stop rollout and return to the isolated pilot scope
notes: Test tenant isolation and least privilege explicitly

control: Run a representative pilot covering install, identity, telemetry, alerts, patch evidence, automation, remote access, reporting, and clean removal
required_evidence: Pilot plan, endpoint list, expected results, observed evidence, defects, retests, and signed decision
validation_method: Reproduce each critical result on approved nonproduction or low-risk systems
risk_if_missing: Unproven workflows can fail at production scale
rollback_or_contingency: Remove the pilot agent and retain existing source management
notes: Define stop conditions before installation

control: Define when both agents may coexist, prohibited combinations, performance limits, security-tool exclusions, and maximum overlap
required_evidence: Approved coexistence matrix with owners, monitoring, time limits, and rollback triggers
validation_method: Test representative endpoint classes and review CPU, memory, disk, network, patch, reboot, and security behavior
risk_if_missing: Overlapping agents can conflict or duplicate privileged actions
rollback_or_contingency: Remove the new agent or disable the conflicting feature under change control
notes: Avoid simultaneous patch or reboot authority

control: Create wave plans with scope, maintenance windows, approvals, communications, stop thresholds, and rollback ownership
required_evidence: Approved change records for pilot and each rollout wave
validation_method: Confirm endpoint lists and owner acknowledgements immediately before execution
risk_if_missing: Broad unbounded changes can create correlated outages
rollback_or_contingency: Stop the wave, preserve logs, and execute the approved rollback
notes: Use stable endpoint identifiers, not display names alone

control: Prepare internal, customer, service-desk, security, vendor, and successor-provider communications
required_evidence: Audience matrix, message templates, contacts, timing, escalation path, and status cadence
validation_method: Run contact validation and a tabletop communication exercise
risk_if_missing: Users and responders may misinterpret expected changes or failures
rollback_or_contingency: Use the incident communication tree and approved status channel
notes: Do not disclose customer-sensitive details across tenants

control: Freeze or tightly govern source configuration changes during final export and cutover
required_evidence: Approved freeze window, exception path, change log, and configuration delta report
validation_method: Compare final source state to the baseline immediately before each wave
risk_if_missing: Late changes can invalidate exports and migration assumptions
rollback_or_contingency: Re-export affected objects or remove them from the wave
notes: Define which emergency changes remain permitted

control: Verify target enrollment, durable endpoint identity, tenant and site mapping, current telemetry, and policy assignment before source removal
required_evidence: Per-endpoint acceptance records with timestamps and target identifiers
validation_method: Reconcile target console data to endpoint-local facts and the approved inventory
risk_if_missing: Removing the source too early can create unmanaged endpoints
rollback_or_contingency: Retain source agent until target acceptance or invoke the rollback window
notes: Do not count an installer success as active management

control: Prove alert routing, ticket creation, escalation, after-hours ownership, suppression, and closure in the target workflow
required_evidence: Controlled alert tests and end-to-end ticket evidence
validation_method: Trigger harmless approved events and trace acknowledgement through closure
risk_if_missing: Health signals may exist without reaching an accountable responder
rollback_or_contingency: Restore source alerting or activate manual monitoring
notes: Test failure and duplicate paths, not only success

control: Prove patch policy, approval, install, reboot, exception, failure, and compliance-report behavior
required_evidence: Controlled patch evidence for representative endpoint classes
validation_method: Reconcile target records to endpoint state and approved maintenance policy
risk_if_missing: Patch coverage or reporting may silently regress
rollback_or_contingency: Suspend target patch authority and retain the approved source process
notes: Keep emergency patching authority explicit

control: Prove scripts, automation, remote support, reporting, and integration workflows before declaring the wave complete
required_evidence: Approved test cases with actor, scope, parameters, outcomes, audit evidence, and defects
validation_method: Run bounded harmless actions and verify both console and endpoint evidence
risk_if_missing: Key service workflows may remain broken after migration
rollback_or_contingency: Use approved manual alternatives and keep the wave open
notes: Do not use customer data in test scripts

control: Use a tested source-agent uninstall method with authority, targeting safeguards, order of operations, and recovery path
required_evidence: Approved uninstall procedure, signed package or command source, pilot result, targeting list, and rollback plan
validation_method: Test removal on representative endpoints and confirm no unrelated tools are removed
risk_if_missing: Unsafe removal can interrupt service or leave privileged residue
rollback_or_contingency: Stop removals and restore the last known-good management path
notes: Remove dependent tools before the source RMM only when required

control: Verify service, process, driver, task, file, registry, certificate, firewall, scheduled-task, local-account, and console-record cleanup
required_evidence: Per-endpoint removal evidence plus approved residual-artifact findings
validation_method: Check endpoint-local state and source-console status after reboot where applicable
risk_if_missing: Residual components can preserve access or produce false coverage
rollback_or_contingency: Isolate affected endpoints and use the approved cleanup procedure
notes: Distinguish harmless logs from active privileged components

control: Reconcile every in-scope asset into migrated, intentionally excluded, retired, unreachable, exception, or failed-removal status
required_evidence: Final population reconciliation with zero unexplained endpoints
validation_method: Compare source inventory, target inventory, CMDB, billing, identity, and exception records
risk_if_missing: Unexplained endpoints can remain unmanaged or billable
rollback_or_contingency: Extend bounded monitoring and assign each exception to an owner
notes: No endpoint should disappear through count subtraction alone

control: Remove technicians, vendor support users, partner links, SSO assignments, API tokens, service accounts, certificates, and delegated access
required_evidence: Revocation register with actor, timestamp, target, result, and independent verification
validation_method: Attempt approved non-destructive access checks and review audit logs
risk_if_missing: Former access paths can remain valid after migration
rollback_or_contingency: Disable at the identity provider or network boundary and investigate
notes: Preserve required break-glass access under separate approval

control: Confirm post-termination access, retention, deletion, backup expiration, legal holds, return formats, and deletion evidence
required_evidence: Vendor confirmation mapped to contract, records policy, and approved exceptions
validation_method: Verify access termination and obtain evidence appropriate to data sensitivity
risk_if_missing: Sensitive data may remain accessible or required records may be deleted
rollback_or_contingency: Escalate unresolved holds and restrict remaining access
notes: A vendor statement is evidence to assess, not proof of every backend deletion

control: Reconcile licenses, endpoint counts, invoices, credits, deposits, renewals, taxes, and payment authority
required_evidence: Final account reconciliation and approved closure statement
validation_method: Compare vendor records with CMDB, target inventory, contract, and finance ledger
risk_if_missing: Billing may continue or credits may be missed
rollback_or_contingency: Dispute unsupported charges through the approved commercial process
notes: Retain source-dated billing evidence

control: Obtain service, security, operations, finance, records, and executive acceptance against defined exit criteria
required_evidence: Signed acceptance matrix with open risks, owners, due dates, and rejected claims
validation_method: Review evidence by domain; do not infer acceptance from project completion
risk_if_missing: The project can close with unresolved coverage, access, data, or cost gaps
rollback_or_contingency: Keep affected workstreams open and retain contingency controls
notes: Acceptance must identify known exceptions

control: Monitor target coverage, alert delivery, patch status, automation failures, access logs, ticket volume, and user impact through a defined stabilization window
required_evidence: Daily stabilization dashboard, incident log, exception queue, and trend review
validation_method: Reconcile at least daily during the highest-risk period and at the agreed closeout date
risk_if_missing: Delayed failures may surface after source access is gone
rollback_or_contingency: Invoke contingency monitoring and escalate breached stop thresholds
notes: Set the duration from risk and change scope, not a default guess

control: Run a final retrospective and archive the approved evidence pack, decisions, unresolved risks, and lessons learned
required_evidence: Closeout report, evidence index, residual-risk acceptance, improvement actions, and next review date
validation_method: Have an independent participant verify evidence accessibility and ownership
risk_if_missing: Future migrations and investigations will repeat avoidable gaps
rollback_or_contingency: Reopen closure for missing evidence or unowned high-risk actions
notes: Store evidence according to classification and retention requirements
